title: hieracium inuloides subsp. fistulosum
intro: Hieracium inuloides subsp. fistulosum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in reducing pain and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium inuloides subsp. fistulosum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and free-radical scavenging activities, as well as its potential to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
